data.why: All 338 Arp targets, telescope specs, and moon-avoidance data are embedded directly in arp_project.html; the page also auto-fetches the repo's own arp_ned_coords.csv from the same folder, so the static file server needs no extra data.

goals: Check tonight's observable Arp targets at a chosen iTelescope site and generate a ready-to-upload ACP plan
Review moon-avoidance risk for upcoming nights to decide which targets to schedule now versus later
Track imaging progress across the 338-target survey and see season completion percentages
Log a completed imaging session (telescope, exposure, filter strategy, quality rating) and flag poor-quality images for re-imaging
Export current survey status and target lists as CSV for backup or sharing

review.summary: The tree correctly covers what the dashboard is for: planning which targets to image each night with moon avoidance, writing ACP plans, logging sessions by quality and tracking completion across the 338 targets, with sound phases and the right depth. It needs small fixes before filing: reorder the planning tasks, remove or annotate hover-tooltip evidence the screenshots don't show, add an Overview feature and filtering steps to f1, and copy check.json's extra findings into not_done.
